nia_resolution.strategy: case-split on discrete governance params (absCapBps, tolBps)
nia_resolution.rationale: concrete x symbolic = linear; symbolic x symbolic = QF_NIA nonlinear (z3 timeout). Fixing cap coefficients to admissible config values makes all products linear in tvl.
